name: How does financing work for new construction properties?

mainEntity.name: How does financing work for new construction properties?

acceptedAnswer.text: Financing for new construction can differ from resale homes, often involving a pre-approval process and sometimes construction loans depending on the build stage. Many builders have preferred lenders who may offer incentives, but it's wise to compare options. Your agent can guide you through understanding these financing structures, including any requirements for deposits, stages of payment, and when interest rates are locked. We can help you compare builder incentives versus independent lender offerings.
acceptedAnswer.description: New construction financing may involve specific builder lenders, construction loans, or stages of payment. Compare builder incentives with independent lenders to find the best terms.
